A work in progress.

VineMix processes audio on your PC, remembers your workspace and keeps automatic settings backups.

Version 0.3.0-beta.3 is available for Windows 11 x64. Automated checks cover synthetic processing and desktop controls; real-device and long-session qualification remain incomplete.

The original application is MIT licensed. Versioned downloads and matching source are on GitHub Releases. Third-party components and audio drivers have their own terms.

Read the application license
What do I need?

Windows 11 x64. Physical microphones and running-app capture work without virtual audio drivers. Virtual input uses separately installed VB-CABLE; the outgoing virtual microphone uses Virtual Audio Cable. Check the driver’s terms, especially for monetized use.

Will app capture mute the original sound?

No. It copies existing playback. Keep the player’s normal headphone audio while sending its captured copy to the virtual microphone. Sending both copies to the same headphones can double the sound.

Does it run on a standalone headset?

The current application runs on Windows 11 x64. The VRChat example is for desktop and PCVR, rather than an application running natively on a standalone headset.
